description: Test vectors of the value-parsing helpers parse_bytes, parse_duration, parse_time and parse_percent, read by the Go tests of the jq functions (internal/expr) and by the tests of the Python transform (internal/transform), so the two implementations give the same value, and the same error, for every input. An input with "output" gives that number; with "error" it fails with exactly that message; with "type_error" it is no text (or, for parse_time and parse_percent, a number) and fails saying what the helper reads.
